DHCPv4::type
       This command returns type of DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::type

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns type of DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::type

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns type of DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Type [DHCPv4::type]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command
